scope: Complete source content screened. Observation entries preserve reviewer uncertainty, duplicates and withdrawn claims; they are not independent verified defects.

visualObservations.text: 1. **[MAJOR] visual-settings-workspace.png** — "Split preview" and "Show sticky notes layer" checkboxes collide with zero spacing (second checkbox touches the first label's last character; zoom-verified).
2. **[MINOR] visual-theme-customizer.png** — "BORDER HIGHLIGHT" input clips its value mid-token: `rgba(148, 163, 184,` with no ellipsis, full color value unreadable.
3. **[MINOR] visual-layout-presets-bottom.png** — scrolled content ghosts through in the sliver above the sticky "Inspector / Rendered output / Tools" bar (zoom-verified).

4. **[MINOR] visual-layout-presets.png** — the identical preset feature is styled differently than Settings → Workspace: teal-outline "Apply" buttons vs gray-border ones, and two opposite active-state treatments ("Tools" white pill vs "Layouts" dark teal pill) in adjacent rows.
5. **[MINOR] visual-color-palettes.png** — white swatch in the "Light Modern" card survives only on a hairline border and reads as an empty slot on the white card.

6. **[MINOR] visual-settings-appearance.png** — action buttons ("Manage color palettes", "Reset appearance defaults") sit ~20px below the field above but nearly touch the next label, making them look attached to unrelated rows (same rhythm flaw in daemon-operations and backups).

7. **[MINOR] visual-settings-shortcuts.png** — every keybinding field has a teal accent border (even rows marked "Default") while the search input is gray; plus "COMMAND"/"SHORTCUT" headers are offset from their content while "ACTIONS" is flush right.
8. **[MINOR] visual-settings-advanced.png / release-quality.png** — section heading "startup" is lowercase vs sentence-case siblings, and metric cards mix "—" and "0" empty states.
9. **[MINOR] visual-settings-backups.png** — "Backup Now" breaks the sentence-case button convention, and its checkbox row is crammed against the help paragraph.
10. **[SUSPECT] visual-settings-dark.png** — "Inbox period" is clipped exactly at the sticky footer edge with its input invisible; verify scroll clearance or the last field is unreachable.

- [SUSPECT] graph canvas (all regions) — every node label except the focus node's is dropped/hidden at this density: only "Research Plan" is labeled across ~120 nodes. This reads as intentional decluttering (it does keep the view legible), but if the design intends labels-on-hover or labels above a zoom threshold, that behavior isn't visible in a static frame → confirm the label-declutter policy is intentional; if not, add progressive label reveal (zoom/hover).

- [MINOR] focus node label ("Research Plan", lower-left) — the label text sits directly against the bottom edge of the cyan focus node and an edge line passes through/behind the label, so the dark text touches both the node halo and a teal edge → add a small background pill or offset the label a few px further below the node.

- [MINOR] center-right dense cluster (~x 620–1030, y 280–520) — several indigo nodes touch or slightly overlap each other (e.g. nodes around the vertical middle of the cluster), making individual node boundaries merge into blobs → increase collision radius / repulsion in the force layout at high node counts.

- [SUSPECT] legend swatch ("Current note", legend strip) — the legend dot is dark green/teal, while the actual current-note node is bright cyan with a dark ring; the fill-vs-outline distinction the legend implies is carried by an unshown outline variant, and swatch color doesn't match the rendered node → align the legend swatch with the focus node's cyan fill + ring styling.

- [POLISH] "Graph depth" slider value "2" (top-right) — the numeric value floats detached at the far right past the slider track's end, with a large gap between track and number → place the value adjacent to the slider end or in a fixed-width readout.

- [SUSPECT] Left frame edge, at the divider between header and body (~1/3 down the left edge) — a small blue/teal fragment is visible at the very edge of the frame, next to the horizontal rule; unclear whether it's a clipped UI accent (e.g. an edge tab or highlight bar) or a JPEG re-encode artifact. ("") → Confirm against the source PNG `visual-graph-disabled-recovery.png`: if it's a real element, keep it inside the panel bounds or clip it intentionally; if it's only an artifact of the small re-encode, ignore.

- [SUSPECT] Body sub-copy, muted gray on white — "Enable the Graph module for this vault to explore note relationships." — contrast looks lighter than the heading; at this 520x218 size it's readable to me but I can't measure the ratio from a JPEG. → Verify the muted text token meets ≥4.5:1 against the panel background (it likely does if it's the standard gray-500-ish token).

- [MAJOR] canvas area vertical composition — empty state is not centered in the canvas area; it hugs the top while a ~370px-tall tinted board panel below is pure dead space. Measured: ~48px from toolbar bottom to the icon top vs ~447px from the "Add first card" button bottom down to the status bar; the empty state block sits in the top ~25% of the surface. → Center the icon/copy/CTA block within the actual board panel (or within the full canvas viewport), so top and bottom margins to the surface edges are roughly equal; move the zoom cluster to overlay the panel rather than sit above it.

- [MINOR] empty-state sub-copy — the instruction points at a control that does not exist in this frame: "Add a card now, or choose a template or tool above." The toolbar above contains only "New board", "0 blocks", "Undo", "Redo", "Export", "Link to active note" — no template picker is visible anywhere. → Add the template entry point to the toolbar/empty state, or reword to only name actions that are actually reachable (e.g. "Add a card now, or link the canvas to an active note.").

- [SUSPECT] empty-state muted text + status text — "Add a card now, or choose a template or tool above.", "0 blocks", and "New board ready." are light gray on white and appear near the readable/low boundary; the thin-stroke "+" icon is similarly faint. → Verify against 4.5:1 (body) / 3:1 (icon) and darken the muted token if it fails.

- [POLISH] primary CTA — "Add first card" is styled as a quiet outline button identical in weight to "Reset view", so the single most important action reads as a secondary control in an otherwise empty screen. → Give it the primary treatment (filled/accent) so it anchors the empty state.

- [POLISH] zoom toolbar — "−", "100%", "+", "Reset view" is fully present at far-left on an empty board ("0 blocks"), where zoom/reset have nothing to act on and visually detach from the centered empty state. → Dim/disable while empty, or float the cluster over the board panel bottom-left so it reads as belonging to the surface.

- [MINOR] Canvas interior — large dead-space band across the full middle of the board and an empty lower-left quadrant; the 5 cards form a sparse top row + bottom row cluster with a ~130px-tall empty horizontal gap and no content left of "Methodology.md" ("Research question", "Evidence", "Synthesis" top row; "Methodology.md", "Research Plan.md" bottom row) → tighten default card placement (e.g. pack cards into a grid or reduce vertical gaps) or auto-fit view to content bounds.

- [MINOR] Bottom-row cards vs canvas bottom edge — "Methodology.md" and "Research Plan.md" sit flush against (or a hair past) the canvas surface's bottom boundary with no breathing room, while the top row has a visible ~10px inset from the canvas top → give cards a consistent margin from the canvas edges or clamp placement inside a padding inset.

- [POLISH] Bottom-row card pair vs canvas centering — "Methodology.md" + "Research Plan.md" span roughly x=358–1157 while the canvas spans the full width, so the pair reads slightly right-of-center relative to the centered top row → center the row on the canvas midpoint.

- [POLISH] Card size vs content — all five cards are large boxes with only a single title line and entirely empty bodies ("Research question", "Evidence", "Synthesis", "Methodology.md", "Research Plan.md"); the two note cards are also visibly wider (~365px) than the three sticky cards (~300px) despite identical content depth → size cards to content or add body/preview text to justify the footprint.

- [SUSPECT] Canvas — no connector lines at all, although the card set reads as a workflow ("Research question" → "Evidence" → "Synthesis" with "Methodology.md"/"Research Plan.md" below); if connectors are expected on a populated board this is a missing-feature gap, otherwise nothing to fix → confirm whether connectors are supposed to render in this fixture.

- [MINOR] canvas panel footer — raw internal identifier shown to the user: "Added sticky-note. 4c3e60e1-7696-4f4d-af84-9337633c5cfe" → replace the UUID with a friendly label (e.g. note title, "just now", or a short id in a tooltip) in the status message.

- [SUSPECT] export menu overlay vs canvas card — the open menu's bottom edge cuts across the card title "Research Plan", slicing the tops of the glyphs mid-character (menu spans roughly x 417–636, bottom edge ~y 238; the title sits at y ~220–248). Popovers normally overlay content, so this may be accepted behavior, but the cut lands exactly on the only content block's title and reads as truncation while the menu is open → if this is deemed a defect, offset the menu or reduce its height/width so the card title stays legible; otherwise no change.

- [POLISH] export menu item rows — menu panel is ~220px wide while the longest label "Export PNG" occupies only ~80px, leaving a large empty right area with no icons, separators, or shortcut column to justify the width → either narrow the menu to content width or add right-aligned keyboard hints (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+S) to balance the row.

- [SUSPECT] menu placement vs trigger — the menu's left edge sits a few pixels left of the "Export ⌄" trigger button's left edge (menu ~x417 vs trigger ~x423), and the menu extends well past the trigger's right edge (~x521 → menu ~x636). Alignment is close enough that this may be a measurement artifact of the JPEG re-encode; if real, anchor the menu flush to the trigger's left edge.

- [MAJOR] Modal body, right region — the three columns (`Todo`/`Doing`/`Done`) span only x≈220–906 of a modal body running to x≈1240; roughly the right third (~330px) of the board area is blank dead space, so the board reads as unfinished/wrong-sized → make columns flex to fill the modal width (or size the modal to the board).

- [MINOR] Cards, all three columns — large dead vertical space inside each card: one-line title at the top (`Draft release notes`, `Verify panel mounts`, `Wire palette command`) and the `<` `>` buttons pinned to the bottom leaves ~40px empty middle band in every card → collapse card height to content or move buttons inline with the title.

- [MINOR] Cards, all columns — no drag affordance visible: no grip handle, drag dots, or hover hint anywhere on the cards; the only move mechanism on screen is the `<` `>` buttons → if drag-and-drop is supported, add a visible grip handle (aligned consistently, e.g. top-left) or cursor/hover affordance.

- [MINOR] Move buttons, all cards — icon-only `<` `>` with no label/tooltip/aria text visible anywhere; placement is consistent (bottom-right, ~7px inset) but the meaning of each chevron is not discoverable from the screen → add tooltips/accessible names ("Move left"/"Move right").

- [SUSPECT] Move buttons, `Todo` card vs `Done` card — disabled presentation looks inconsistent: `Done`'s `>` is visibly lighter/gray (plausibly the disabled state), while `Todo`'s `<` (which should be disabled — nothing is left of Todo) renders white with a dark chevron, indistinguishable from the enabled `>` beside it → verify disabled styling is applied to both ends of the board; JPEG contrast makes me unsure of the exact fill.

- [SUSPECT] Left sidebar — labels read `New from t…` and `Today · 202…` where the modal's left edge (x≈185) cuts across them; the `…` suggests real ellipsis truncation, but the modal occlusion means I cannot confirm whether it is a truncation defect or just overlap → check these rows in an unobstructed capture.

- [SUSPECT] Board framing — the kanban surface is a floating modal (~1070×325 at frame center) over the markdown editor (`kanban-plugin: basic` visible behind it), not a docked workspace surface; margins are symmetric and the modal is vertically centered, so it looks deliberate, but if the intended design is an embedded board pane this presentation is wrong → confirm intended placement.

- [MINOR] Column 1 "Todo" card ("Draft release notes") — its "‹" move button renders fully enabled (solid border, dark chevron) even though the leftmost column has nowhere to move left, while the mirror case is handled in "Done" where "›" is visibly disabled → apply the same disabled styling/behavior to "‹" in the first column as to "›" in the last.

- [MINOR] Column 3 "Done" card ("Wire palette command") — the disabled "›" button is nearly invisible (border gone, chevron almost matches the background), so it reads as a missing control rather than a disabled one → keep a visible border and use a clear disabled tint (e.g. ~50% opacity on border + icon) plus `aria-disabled`.

- [MINOR] All three cards ("Draft release notes", "Verify panel mounts", "Wire palette command") — dead space: the title sits on the top row and the move buttons float at bottom-right, leaving an empty band roughly 35–45px tall between them for a single-line title → move the "‹" "›" buttons up onto the title row (right-aligned) or shrink the card height to fit its content.

- [MINOR] Board area right of the "Done" column and beneath the columns — the three columns fill only ~two-thirds of the frame width and stop ~60px above the panel's bottom edge, leaving an L-shaped empty region in this short/wide 1080x316 frame → let columns stretch to fill the panel width (or distribute the slack) and size the panel to the board's height.

- [SUSPECT] Cards — no drag grip handles (⋮⋮ or similar) are visible anywhere; the only move affordance is the "‹" "›" buttons → if drag-to-move is supported, add a grip handle so the affordance is discoverable; if buttons are the sole mechanism, this is fine.

- [POLISH] Row alignment, all 3 rows — Save buttons sit exactly 1px lower than their inputs (button spans y167–202 / 242–277 / 317–352 vs input fills 166–201 / 241–276 / 316–351; identical 1px offset per row) ("Save") → snap button box to input box.

- [POLISH] Field column, right edge — three identical always-enabled "Save" buttons with no dirty-state indication, so it's unclear which field is unsaved ("Save", "Save", "Save") → disable per-row Save until the field is edited, or autosave and drop the buttons.

- [SUSPECT] Input fills — fields render in a filled gray-green (rgb 232,242,240) that conventionally signals disabled/read-only, yet each pairs with an active Save ("Scriptor research", "active", "research, methods") → if editable, switch to the standard editable-input style; if read-only, remove Save.

- [POLISH] Panel bottom vs top — whitespace below the "tags" row measures ~18px to the panel border vs ~28px above the "Frontmatter" cap-height; the panel looks bottom-tight ("tags" / "research, methods") → equalize vertical padding.

- [SUSPECT] Bottom-right corner (x≈712–716, y≈365–371) — 2–5px sliver of unrelated dark/gray pixels visible outside the panel's rounded corner → expected if this panel floats over the workspace (behind-content bleed); otherwise crop/mask the corner.

- [MAJOR] Vault health card — three contradictory states at once: a "→ Loading..." badge, eight tiles already showing final-looking values ("Broken links 0", "Orphan assets 0", …, "Vault words 0"), and global status "No vault open". Zeros read as measured data and the loading badge says they're not final yet → show skeletons/blank tiles while loading and replace the card with an explicit "No vault open" empty state rather than zeros.
